FIND: `_prune_packet_directives` reverts to the full original text if all directives in a packet are pruned. When `max_chars` is small and all blocks are SOFT, `retained` becomes empty, making `pruned_text` an empty string `""`. The return statement `text=pruned_text if pruned_text else packet.text` evaluates to `False` and restores the packet to 100% of its original length.
FOLLOW: When a packet is entirely composed of SOFT constraints and needs heavy pruning to meet the coherence budget, Pass 1 pruning reduces it to `""`. The fallback restores it to full length, causing Pass 1 to fail to reduce the token count. This forces Pass 2 to drop the entire packet (or causes the budget check to fail entirely if it was the last prunable packet).
ANALYSE: HARD constraint (logic error). The fallback assumes an empty string means "pruning failed", but it actually means "pruning succeeded completely". The function must return the empty string to reflect the pruned state. CONFIRMED.
